rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for consent or agreement, especially in everyday situations.

example.english: I've got your approval, so we can start.
example.traditional: 我攞到你嘅同意，就可以開始喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lo2 dou2 nei5 ge3 tung4 ji3 zau6 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for endorsement or acceptance of a proposal, person, or point of view rather than simple permission.

example.english: You have my approval for that point of view.
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 ngo5 hou2 jing6 tung4

rows.note: Use this for official or administrative authorization, such as approval of an application or purchase order.

example.english: The department has given approval to my purchase order.
example.traditional: 部門已經批准咗我張採購單。
example.jyutping: bou6 mun4 ji5 ging1 pai1 zeon2 zo2 ngo5 zoeng1 coi2 kau3 daan1

rows.note: Use this when approval is expressed as praise, appreciation, or an encouraging compliment.

example.english: The boss publicly praised our effort, showing his approval.
example.traditional: 老闆公開讚賞我哋嘅努力。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 gung1 hoi1 zaan3 soeng2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 nou5 lik6
